# Issues

Use a form rather than a blank issue:

- [Bug report](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml)
- [Feature request](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml)
- [Connector request](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/connector_request.yml)
- [Documentation](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/documentation.yml)

**Do not paste credentials, JWTs, private tenant exports, or unsanitized scan output.**
Replace secrets with `${REDACTED}`.

- Security and redaction failures: [private advisory](https://github.com/aisecnomad/Project-Nexus/security/advisories/new)
- Questions and routing: [SUPPORT.md](../SUPPORT.md)
- How to contribute: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
